_note: A second, harder set of hand-labelled queries (document level), added because semantic and hybrid search both scored 100% on qrels.json. Every label was checked against the text of the sample documents. 'keyword' = exact identifiers, numbers or rare names; 'semantic' = paraphrases that avoid the document's own words and have look-alike distractors in other documents (telescopes, light, images); 'multi' = more than one document is correct. Queries nobody can answer from the corpus are NOT included, because the metrics need at least one relevant document.
